articles.title: Most National Parks Won’t Require Reservations This Summer
articles.mainIdea: Most National Parks Won’t Require Reservations This Summer
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: Most National Parks Won’t Require Reservations This Summer. Arches, Glacier and Yosemite have discontinued their programs that urged visitors to book time slots for entry.

articles.title: David Tepper’s Appaloosa Trims Alibaba and Adds Micron, Alphabet in Stock Reshuffle
articles.mainIdea: David Tepper’s Appaloosa Trims Alibaba and Adds Micron, Alphabet in Stock Reshuffle
articles.summary: Barrons.com: David Tepper’s Appaloosa Trims Alibaba and Adds Micron, Alphabet in Stock Reshuffle. Appaloosa’s single largest increase in holdings by dollar value was for chip maker Micron It acquired 1 million new shares, for a total of 1.5 million valued at $428 million at the end of 2025. It also bumped up its Alphabet holdings to around 1.8 million shares, valued at around $560 million for the same period. Related tickers mentioned: 000660.KS, AMD, BABA, BABAF, BLK, CZR, EWY, GOOG, MU, SSNLF, UBER.
